annotations.title: Replace text in a project file

description:
Replace text in an existing project file. The text must match exactly once unless replace_all is set; the write is guarded by the file's sha256. Then check scripts with summer_get_script_errors.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/replace-text"}

replace_all.description: Replace every exact occurrence instead of requiring one unique match.
